Keep the lavender/purple rolled-sleeve blouse, dark brown suspenders and brass buckles, high-waisted purple trousers, grey knitted socks, dark worn lace-up boots, and her existing PURPLE NECKERCHIEF with its tied knot/bow and pointed ends. STYLE: precisely match the source's fine dark hand-inked contours, warm soft lighting, richly textured gouache/watercolour pigment, illustrated storybook realism, lived-in fabrics and polished wood/brass details. Preserve the source palette and level of detail; not anime, 3D, photorealism or a different rendering style.

Keep the figure and chair at a consistent game-sprite scale, wheel/footplate baseline near 94% of the canvas height, and at least 5% clear margin around every extremity, wheel, boot, hair and fist. The whole character/chair must fit; no cropping. Genuine transparent alpha around the silhouette AND through every open gap between arms, body, wheels, spokes and frame. No background, backdrop, vignette, glow, floor, ground shadow, debris, impact particles, motion trails, opponent, text, frame, watermark, blood, injury or damage.
